description: This Java source file defines the ThingPersistenceActor class, an Akka actor responsible for persisting and managing the state of a single Thing object within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes configuration, lifecycle management, event publishing, and recovery handling.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages persistence and lifecycle of a single Thing object, including configuration, event handling, recovery, and publishing.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the actor with specified parameters.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the unique persistence ID for this actor based on the entity ID.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the journal plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the snapshot plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the event managed by this actor.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Provides the context for command strategies, including logging and entity ID.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the command strategy used for creating a new Thing.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the command strategy used for deleting a Thing.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Returns the event strategy for handling Thing events.

methods.name: entityExistsAsDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the entity exists and is marked as deleted.

methods.name: newNotAccessibleExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new exception builder for access issues.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Handles actor recovery completion, updating entity state and logging.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes a ThingEvent to the distributed pub system.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version implemented by the entity.

methods.name: enhanceThingWithLifecycle
methods.description: Ensures the Thing has a lifecycle state, defaulting to ACTIVE if missing.
